_readme: EXEMPTIONS from tooling/ci/assert-credential-origin.mjs, which READS this file. One row per CALL SITE: {path, limb, at, reason}. A row suppresses a finding only when the finding's own line contains `at`, never a whole file (2026-10-01, review of #1097 finding 2: a file-wide row let a new service-role send in an exempted file pass). Limb P = the file reads a credential at this line, sends, and never calls credentialOrigin(); limb R = a base-URL variable is read or used raw at this line.

A row is a REASON, checked by a person at review: the guard cannot see it. A row that suppresses nothing any more is a finding (STALE), so a row dies with its call site. Add one only when the credential still reaches its issuer alone by a path the guard's one-binding rule cannot follow, or when the credential is public by design.

exempt.reason: BASE is api()'s default `base` parameter, and api() pins it with credentialOrigin(base, 'glitchtip') on its first line, before any fetch. Its one other use is a dry-run log line in ensure-monitors.mjs, which sends nothing.
The service-role key read here goes only to mintMagicLinkTokenHash() in tooling/e2e/magic_link.mjs, which pins SUPABASE_URL with credentialOrigin(url, 'supabase') before its one request.
Not a send: the key is deleted from process.env the line after it is read, so no flutter, chromedriver or node child this file spawns inherits it.

Passed as `url` to mintMagicLinkTokenHash() (tooling/e2e/magic_link.mjs), which pins it with credentialOrigin(url, 'supabase') before the request; the binding is a call argument the one-binding rule cannot follow.

Copied into baseEnv only. This file sends no request itself; every child that inherits baseEnv is listed here: `flutter --version` and `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (send no Supabase credential), tooling/e2e/provision_user.mjs, tooling/store/capture-play-screenshots.mjs (through magic_link.mjs) and tooling/e2e/purge.mjs, each of which pins SUPABASE_URL with credentialOrigin() before its first request.

The anon key is public by design (every web build ships it). Copied into baseEnv only, for the same children as the service-role row: flutter --version, flutter pub get, provision_user.mjs, capture-play-screenshots.mjs and purge.mjs.

Copied into baseEnv only. The children that send with it each pin it first: provision_user.mjs and purge.mjs directly, capture-play-screenshots.mjs through magic_link.mjs. flutter --version and flutter pub get send nothing to it.
SELFHOSTED_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is the public anon key every web build ships. Its target is an operator's --target for a box that is not live yet, which the issuer pin would refuse by design.
SELFHOSTED_SUPABASE_URL is the default for --target, a box the preflight exists to check before it becomes the issuer; only the public anon key goes there.
Not a send: this line only names where the target came from, for the run's one log line.
The public anon key every web build ships, sent to auth/v1/settings on the box this script verifies; no admin key is read.
Not a send: a boolean that only chooses how the auth URL is named in the log (fingerprint or default).
SELFHOSTED_SUPABASE_URL (default BOXC_DEFAULT_TARGET) receives only the public anon key; the settings read is the verification of that box.

Not a send: the build command it assembles passes the public anon key as a --dart-define into the app the build ships, where the app's own SUPABASE_URL define is the committed, register-checked origin.
Not a send: a --dart-define placeholder for the shell of the release job, compiled into the app; the value is the repository secret the release lanes and connect-origins.mjs already grade.
Not a send: a --dart-define placeholder compiled into the app as its crash-sink DSN, a public ingest credential; assert-seams-wired.mjs grades that every release build supplies it.
